main_text.p: que fidem tenuerit, sine qua pie recteq; non viuitur, tam multa, tamq; multipli-cibus mysteriorum umbraculis opaca intelligenda proficientibus restant: tanq; non solum in verbis quibus ista dicta sunt, verum etiam in rebus quæ intelligendæ sunt, latet altitudo sapientiæ, ut annosissimis, acutissimis, flagrantissimis cupiditate discendi hoc contingat, quod eadem scriptura quodam loco habet: Cum consummauerit homo, tunc incipit.Hæc Augustinus epist.3.ad Volusianum.Quapropter merito commendantur ii, qui in explicanda scriptura multum operæ atque studii ponunt. Neq; vero deterrere bonos & doctos viros debet, quod antehac in enarran-dis libris sacris elaborarint cum veteres, tum recentiores Theologi, quorum doctissimi extant commētarii. Nihil enim minus illis propositum fuit, quàm ut e cœlesti thesauro noua atq; vetera depro-mendi, & ex Dei verbo, tanquam pena-rio aut amplissimo promptuario mul-tiplicem

page.notes: No printed notes outside the text block. Pencil marks in the left margin (slash-like strokes beside the lines "ut annosissimis" to "scriptura") and a faint mark at the lower right edge are not printed text and are left out. Passages with doubtful readings: "recteq;" (the abbreviation mark after "recte" is slightly unclear), "commētarii" (macron over e is faint), and "epist.3.ad" (the numeral 3 may be a superscript). Printing errors left as printed: "epist.3.ad" with no space and "incipit.Hæc" with no space.
